sentences.text:
3.  Ajeet Kumar Agrawal S/o Shri Om Prakash Agrawal, Aged About 48 Years R/o Village  Darba, Tahsil Kurud, District Dhamtari (Chhattisgarh)
 ---- Respondents 16.10.2023 Mr. Dhiraj Kumar Wankhede, Advocate for petitioner.
Mr. Rahul Jha, Govt. Advocate for the State.
Heard.

Mr. Rahul Jha, learned State counsel accepts notice on behalf of respondents no. 1 & 2.
Issue notice to respondent no. 3 on payment of process fee as per rules.
Notice be made returnable within three weeks.
Also heard on I.A. No. 01/2023, which is an application for grant of interim relief.

Learned counsel for petitioner submits that initially respondent no. 2 has passed the award on 12.07.2016, after passing of the award, respondent no. 2 authority became functus officio to consider any application for enhancement of the award.

The party aggrieved with the computation of the award has the remedy under Section 3G of the National Highways Act 1956, the supplementary award passed enhancing the award of compensation is without jurisdiction.

He also submits that the issue with regard to jurisdiction of the SDO(R) for passing supplementary award or modifying the award of land acquisition after passing of an award is considered by this Court in WPC No. 665/2019 (Mahesh Nachrani and others vs. Union of India) reported in 2020 SCC OnLine Chh 759 in which it is held that SDO(R) cannot review and modify the award already passed.

entities.text: Mahesh Nachrani and others vs. Union of India) reported in 2020 SCC OnLine Chh 759
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned
State counsel submits that he will file reply to the application for interim relief.

Considering the submission of learned counsel for petitioner based on the order passed in Mahesh Nachrani (supra), purely as an interim measure, it is directed that there shall be stay of the order Annexure P-1 dated 09.06.2022 passed by SDO(R) till the next date of hearing.
